-- CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'Vivekbhand@2712'

-----------------------
--- CREATE CREDENTIALS
-----------------------

CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL vivcreds
WITH 
     IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'


---------------------------
--- CREATE EXT DATA SOURCE
---------------------------


CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://vivdatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/raw',
    CREDENTIAL = vivcreds
)

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source_abfss
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'abfss://raw@vivdatalake.dfs.core.windows.net',
    CREDENTIAL = vivcreds
)

-------------------------------
--- CREATE PARQUET FILE FORMAT
-------------------------------

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH(
    FORMAT_TYPE= PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)
